speaker: Elder Kevin J. Hathaway
title: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!
session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Kevin J. Hathaway spoke about “Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!”.

quotes.text: Have you ever felt left out, wondered if you were enough, lost someone you loved, faced illness, experienced family difficulties, or carried a burden no one else could see? My message today is that Jesus Christ delivers the righteous from these and every other affliction of mortality.
quotes.speaker: Elder Kevin J. Hathaway
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Our family experienced a sudden trial and the Lord’s deliverance as we drove in two cars to begin our service as mission leaders. While driving in a construction zone, two large tires came loose from a semitruck and struck both cars at high speed. The airbags deployed, the cars were destroyed, and we were left stranded on the roadside wondering why this had happened when we had left everything to serve the Lord.
quotes.speaker: Elder Kevin J. Hathaway
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Opposition comes to all, even the righteous. It can stir heartrending questions and deep emotions, like Joseph Smith’s cry from Liberty Jail, “O God, where art thou?” or the grief and fear felt by Helaman’s stripling warriors. Such questions and emotions are not sin or weakness; they can create a sacred space where agency is activated and we choose whether to turn toward Jesus Christ.
quotes.speaker: Elder Kevin J. Hathaway
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Sincere seeking means turning toward Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ through heartfelt prayer, purposeful fasting, and scripture study. Alma’s people in bondage “began to cry mightily to God.” King Darius fasted through the night as he waited for Daniel’s deliverance from the lions’ den. Such acts of faith draw us closer to Jesus Christ.
quotes.speaker: Elder Kevin J. Hathaway
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Enabled enduring comes through the grace of Jesus Christ and strengthens us to “cheerfully do all things that lie in our power” and then “stand still, with the utmost assurance, to see the salvation of God, and for his arm to be revealed.” This grace does not remove the pain and difficulty of affliction; it is an enabling power that allows us, after all we can do, to receive divine strength beyond our own and lay hold on eternal promises through Jesus Christ.
quotes.speaker: Elder Kevin J. Hathaway
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: As Kenzie binds herself to Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ in prayer, obedience, and covenant keeping, They help her endure what she cannot bear alone. That same enabling grace is available to all who turn to Jesus Christ.
quotes.speaker: Elder Kevin J. Hathaway
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: To Kenzie and all who wait for divine deliverance, I testify that the Lord is not delayed, distracted, or derelict in His deliverance. He has not forgotten you. He does not take joy in your suffering. However, He knows that lessons learned while waiting can bring converting growth that an earlier rescue might not produce.
quotes.speaker: Elder Kevin J. Hathaway
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: To all who continue to face the pain, fear, and loneliness of life, I echo the Savior’s words: “Be not afraid, only believe.” In His time and way, Jesus Christ will deliver you. Some miracles are immediate, some come after long waiting, and some await the Resurrection.
quotes.speaker: Elder Kevin J. Hathaway
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference
